answer: Sybil resistance comes from a per-identity entry bond plus an epoch work challenge, both keyed to the signing key. A bonded agent cannot vouch for a clone: rewards and slashing follow the key, so one operator running a thousand puppets must post a thousand separate bonds and burn a thousand separate compute budgets, as logged for atlas, crystal and sable. The marginal cost of a fake identity stays at the full bond plus work, never the near-zero cost of an extra database row, so mass impersonation is priced out before any vote lands.
